entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:1
segments: ¶Who [is] as the wise [man]? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed. {the boldness: Heb. the strength}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:2
segments: I [counsel thee] to keep the king's commandment, and [that] in regard of the oath of God.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:3
segments: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:4
segments: Where the word of a king [is, there is] power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:5
segments: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment. {shall...: Heb. shall know}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:6
segments: ¶Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man [is] great upon him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:7
segments: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be? {when...: or, how it shall be?}

words.text: not that which shall be: for who can tell
him when it shall be? {when...: or, how it shall be?}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:8
segments: [There is] no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither [hath he] power in the day of death: and [there is] no discharge in [that] war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it. {discharge: or, casting off weapons}

words.text: to it. {discharge: or, casting off weapons}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:9
segments: ¶All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: [there is] a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.

words.text: over another to his own hurt

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:10
segments: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this [is] also vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:11
segments: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:12
segments: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his [days] be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:13
segments: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong [his] days, [which are] as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.

words.text: But it shall not be well

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:14
segments: ¶There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just [men], unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked [men], to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also [is] vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:15
segments: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:16
segments: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also [there is that] neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:17
segments: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek [it] out, yet he shall not find [it]; yea further; though a wise [man] think to know [it], yet shall he not be able to find [it].

words.text: [it], yet shall he not be able
